title.narrative: Construire des preuves pour la prise de décision (BE4D)
Generación de evidencia para la toma de decisiones (BE4D)

description.narrative: (USAID Central America Regional): The Central America Service Corps (CASC)-Central America Youth Empowerment Program (CAYEP) MEL Platform provides coordination support for region-wide analysis, synthesis, and learning for activities that fall under the CASC initiative. The platform includes support for learning priorities and/or questions to guide the generation and use of evidence to better develop this regional initiative. This platform will provide MEL support specifically by developing and implementing a regional CASC learning agenda and MEL framework, providing primary and secondary data analysis and synthesis; and organizing and facilitating a community of practice.
Building Evidence for Decision-Making (BE4D) fournit à l'USAID et à ses partenaires des services MEL et CLA afin que les preuves soient utilisées pour la prise de décision.
Building Evidence for Decision-Making (BE4D) proporciona a USAID y sus socios servicios MEL y CLA para que la evidencia se utilice para la toma de decisiones.
